_comments.schemaVersion: Version of this file. The advisor supports 1.
_comments.ranges: Allowed values of integer parameters. min and max are inclusive; choices lists every allowed value. A bound that is not written is not checked.
_comments.relations: Rules between parameters. saveFreqLteSteps requires SAVE_FREQ <= STEPS. logFreqLteSaveFreq requires LOG_FREQ <= SAVE_FREQ. policyPretrainedPairs lists the PRETRAINED_PATH values allowed for each POLICY_TYPE; the PRETRAINED_PATH of the previous run is always allowed.
_comments.maxChangedKeys: Largest number of parameters one proposal may change from the previous run.
_comments.maxChangeFactor: Largest ratio between the proposed and the previous value of an integer parameter, in either direction.
_comments.fixedKeys: Parameters that must keep the value of the previous run.
_comments.warnings: Values that are allowed but reported as warnings. Each entry names a parameter, the values that trigger the warning, and the message.
_comments.note: STEPS and SAVE_FREQ have a lower bound of 1, the same as the poller allow list, so that short smoke runs such as STEPS 20 with SAVE_FREQ 20 can keep or extend their own values; maxChangeFactor limits how far one proposal moves them. NUM_WORKERS max follows '#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=8' in slurm_train.sh. The FINETUNE_MODE warning follows the GPU memory section of lerobot_pi05_training.md.

warnings.message: may not fit in a 24 GB GPU; prepare a GPU with more memory
